payload.text: **ALL OF cc's WORK, 0595 INCLUDED, IS HELD UNTIL hv GIVES THE RESTART after the estate-wide localfold and compact cycle (hv's word of 2026-10-14, relayed by another estate's session and by vc).** The cycle: every node localfolds and commits its own, hv compacts each session, then /in-session and the pickup, then this hold until hv gives the restart once every session has folded and compacted.
